vulnerabilities.title: Imperva SecureSphere Management Server Remote Command Execution / Auth Bypass

kev_details.vulnerability_name: Imperva SecureSphere Management Server Remote Command Execution / Auth Bypass Vulnerability

vulnerabilities.precondition_description: HTTP Web GUI interface active (webGuiPort configured)
vulnerabilities.mitigation_cmd: Restrict Web GUI access via firewall rules or upgrade SecureSphere to 14.8.0+
vulnerabilities.description: Authentication bypass and remote code execution vulnerability in Imperva SecureSphere MX Management Server web administration console.

vulnerabilities.title: Imperva SecureSphere Management Console Command Injection

kev_details.vulnerability_name: Imperva SecureSphere Management Console Command Injection Vulnerability

vulnerabilities.precondition_description: HTTP Web GUI interface active (webGuiPort configured)
vulnerabilities.mitigation_cmd: Restrict management access to isolated management network and upgrade to 14.8.0+
vulnerabilities.description: Command injection vulnerability in SecureSphere WAF management interface allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
